def factorial(n)
  return 1 if n <= 1
  n * factorial(n - 1)
end

puts factorial(5)

function factorial($n) {
    if ($n <= 1) {
        return 1;
    }
    return $n * factorial($n - 1);
}

code.ruby:
def fibonacci(n)
  a, b = 0, 1
  n.times do
    a, b = b, a + b
  end
  a
end

puts fibonacci(10)

    for ($i = 0; $i < $n; $i++) {
        [$a, $b] = [$b, $a + $b];
    }
    return $a;
}

code.ruby:
def gcd(a, b)
  while b != 0
    a, b = b, a % b
  end
  a
end

code.ruby:
def is_prime(n)
  return 0 if n < 2
  i = 2
  while i * i <= n
    return 0 if n % i == 0
    i += 1
  end
  1
end

puts is_prime(29)
code.php:

function is_prime($n) {
    if ($n < 2) {
        return 0;
    }
    $i = 2;
    while ($i * $i <= $n) {
        if ($n % $i == 0) {
            return 0;
        }
        $i += 1;
    }
    return 1;
}

  total = 0
  numbers.each do |number|
    total += number
  end
  total
end

code.ruby:
def maximum(numbers)
  largest = numbers[0]
  numbers.each do |number|
    largest = number if number > largest
  end
  largest
end

puts maximum([3, 9, 2, 7, 1])

    $largest = $numbers[0];
    foreach ($numbers as $number) {
        if ($number > $largest) {
            $largest = $number;
        }
    }
    return $largest;
}

code.ruby:
def reverse_string(text)
  result = ""
  text.each_char do |character|
    result = character + result
  end
  result
end

puts reverse_string("poly")

    for ($i = 0; $i < $length; $i++) {
        $result = $text[$i] . $result;
    }
    return $result;
}

code.ruby:
def is_palindrome(text)
  left, right = 0, text.length - 1
  while left < right
    return 0 if text[left] != text[right]
    left += 1
    right -= 1
  end
  1
end

puts is_palindrome("level")

<?php
function is_palindrome($text) {
    $left = 0;
    $right = strlen($text) - 1;
    while ($left < $right) {
        if ($text[$left] !== $text[$right]) {
            return 0;
        }
        $left += 1;
        $right -= 1;
    }
    return 1;
}

code.ruby:
def binary_search(numbers, target)
  left, right = 0, numbers.length - 1
  while left <= right
    middle = (left + right) / 2
    return middle if numbers[middle] == target
    if numbers[middle] < target
      left = middle + 1
    else
      right = middle - 1
    end
  end
  -1
end

puts binary_search([1, 3, 5, 7, 9], 7)
code.php:
<?php
function binary_search($numbers, $target) {
    $left = 0;
    $right = count($numbers) - 1;
    while ($left <= $right) {
        $middle = intdiv($left + $right, 2);
        if ($numbers[$middle] == $target) {
            return $middle;
        }
        if ($numbers[$middle] < $target) {
            $left = $middle + 1;
        } else {
            $right = $middle - 1;
        }
    }
    return -1;
}

echo binary_search([1, 3, 5, 7, 9], 7) . "\n";

code.ruby:
def bubble_sort(numbers)
  numbers = numbers.dup
  numbers.length.times do |i|
    (numbers.length - i - 1).times do |j|
      if numbers[j] > numbers[j + 1]
        numbers[j], numbers[j + 1] = numbers[j + 1], numbers[j]
      end
    end
  end
  numbers
end

p bubble_sort([5, 1, 4, 2, 8])
code.php:
<?php
function bubble_sort($numbers) {
    // PHP passes arrays by value, so this already works on a copy (like numbers[:]).
    $n = count($numbers);
    for ($i = 0; $i < $n; $i++) {
        for ($j = 0; $j < $n - $i - 1; $j++) {
            if ($numbers[$j] > $numbers[$j + 1]) {
                [$numbers[$j], $numbers[$j + 1]] = [$numbers[$j + 1], $numbers[$j]];
            }
        }
    }
    return $numbers;
}

echo "[" . implode(", ", bubble_sort([5, 1, 4, 2, 8])) . "]\n";
